dimensions.label: Critical-Path Delivery
dimensions.summary: Hard, consequential code landed, weighted by how load-bearing the system is.
dimensions.formula: Σ per PR: criticality × log2(1 + effective churn) × cross-area spread × test bonus × change-type; capped at 15/PR, repeated templated PRs dampened 1/j, and the k-th PR in the same area × k^-0.4.

dimensions.label: Review Leverage
dimensions.summary: Being the human gate on other people's hard changes (AI reviewers excluded).
dimensions.formula: Σ per reviewed PR: review depth (change request 1.0 … rubber stamp 0.3) × complexity of the PR reviewed × 1.2 if sole human reviewer; × breadth factor for distinct authors unblocked (saturates at 10).

dimensions.label: Keystone Stewardship
dimensions.summary: Owning a large share of a critical, busy system: the bus-factor question turned into credit.
dimensions.formula: Top 3 critical areas (criticality ≥ 0.7, ≥ 5 PRs): criticality × engineer's share of area work (authored + ½ review credit) × log2(1 + PRs in area).

dimensions.label: Sustained & Durable
dimensions.summary: Meaningful contribution across the quarter, and work that isn't reverted.
dimensions.formula: Share of the 13 weeks with a substantive PR (score ≥ 4) or ≥ 2 substantive reviews, × (1 − min(0.5, 2 × revert rate)).
